definitions.gloss: adult insect; imago; fully grown insect
definitions.explanation: An insect that has completed all stages of metamorphosis and reached its final, mature form. Contrasts with larva and pupa stages.

examples.japanese: {幼虫|ようちゅう}が{成虫|せいちゅう}になる。
examples.english: The larva becomes an adult insect.

examples.japanese: カブトムシの{成虫|せいちゅう}は{夏|なつ}にしか{見|み}られない。
examples.english: Adult rhinoceros beetles can only be seen in summer.

examples.japanese: セミは{成虫|せいちゅう}になってからの{寿命|じゅみょう}が{非常|ひじょう}に{短|みじか}い。
examples.english: Cicadas have a very short lifespan after becoming adults.

notes:
{成虫|せいちゅう} is the final stage in an insect's life cycle — the fully developed adult form capable of reproduction.

LIFE CYCLE STAGES:
- {卵|たまご}: egg
- {幼虫|ようちゅう}: larva
- {蛹|さなぎ}: pupa, chrysalis
- {成虫|せいちゅう}: adult insect (imago)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {成虫|せいちゅう}になる: to become an adult (insect)
- {成虫|せいちゅう}の{寿命|じゅみょう}: adult insect's lifespan
- {成虫|せいちゅう}に{羽化|うか}する: to emerge as an adult (from pupa)

FORMS:
{成|せい} (mature, complete) + {虫|ちゅう} (insect).

Used in science education ({理科|りか}) and nature observation. Japanese children often learn this vocabulary through カブトムシ (rhinoceros beetle) and セミ (cicada) life cycles.
